meta.title: Auto PR-to-PO Conversion with SAP PR Sync Mode missing or misconfigured (DEP-002)
gaps: Deliberately leave integration.sap.pr.sync_mode missing or set it to an unspecified misconfigured value while configuring Auto PR-to-PO Conversion.
Observe whether a Procol PO synchronizes to SAP or leaves inconsistent records between Procol and SAP.
Verify SAP-side prevention or remediation of the misconfiguration.

plan.title: PR-to-PO Conversion with Missing SAP Sync Mode

steps.note: Satisfy the case's conditional SAP integration prerequisite.
Enable the feature whose PR-to-PO behavior is being exercised.
Commit a bidding schedule so the event can be published.
Add the event's available vendor participant.
Assert that the event became a real published project.
Create a vendor bid needed for award and downstream PO creation.
Close the bidding event so it can be awarded.
Award the event to the lowest available bid.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.
Exercise the available Procol purchase-order creation path after award.
Verify the resulting PO carries the awarded PR-derived line items.
